questions.prompt: In the recommended Web API folder structure, where does business logic live, and what belongs in `Controllers/`?
options: Business logic in `Controllers/`; `Services/` holds HTTP endpoints
Business logic in `Services/`; controllers are HTTP endpoints only
Business logic in `Repositories/`; controllers also do data access
Business logic in `DTOs/`; controllers hold the validation rules
questions.explanation: Controllers are HTTP endpoints only, services hold business logic, repositories do data access, and validators hold the DTO rules.

questions.prompt: Put the lines of the standard controller-based `Program.cs` in order.
questions.explanation: Services are registered on `builder.Services` before `Build()`; after that the pipeline is configured (Swagger in Development, HTTPS redirection), controllers are mapped, and `Run()` starts the app.

questions.prompt: In the standard `Program.cs`, when is the Swagger UI served?
options: Only after `app.Run()` has been called twice
Only when HTTPS redirection is turned off
questions.explanation: `UseSwagger()` and `UseSwaggerUI()` are wrapped in `if (app.Environment.IsDevelopment())`, so the docs UI is available only in Development.

questions.prompt: With `[ApiController]` on the sample `ProductsController`, what happens when model validation fails?
options: ASP.NET Core returns HTTP 400 automatically with a `ValidationProblemDetails` body
The action runs and must check `ModelState` itself
ASP.NET Core returns HTTP 500 with a stack trace
The request is retried without the invalid fields
questions.explanation: `[ApiController]` turns model validation errors into an automatic 400 whose default body is `ValidationProblemDetails`; it also requires attribute routing.

questions.prompt: In the "best default template", what is `options.Filters.Add<ValidationFilter>()` for?
options: It registers every FluentValidation validator in the assembly
It is required for `MapControllers()` to find any controller
It adds a global filter for filter-based validation, so actions don't need validation code
questions.explanation: The comment says it is needed only for filter-based validation; the validators themselves are registered separately with `AddValidatorsFromAssemblyContaining<Program>()`.

source.section: Best default template to start with
